description: In Memory Of / THOSE WHO DIED WHEN A HALIFAX BOMBER OF NO.433 Sqdn. / ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE / CRASHED AT LONAN ON 14TH JULY 1944 / SOME WRECKAGE FELL ON A HOUSE "HOKANG" PINFOLD HILL / FATALLY INJURING A CHILD. / Crew / (names)
